about: Christian Schäfer, Sight Reading Exercises Op. 45 (Augener, 1908), public domain. Notes: letter, optional accidental (# b n), octave, duration (w h q 8 16), optional d = dot, optional ~ = tie to next note. Chords: join pitches with + before the duration, e.g. c4+e4+g4h. Rests: r + duration. Invisible spacer (for a second voice that is silent): x + duration. Bars separated by |. Key-signature accidentals are implied. If lh is omitted, the left hand plays the right hand an octave lower. Optional rh2 / lh2 hold a second voice in that hand (stems down); every voice needs the same number of bars.
